onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event from the beginning of the first datapoint. Negative onsets account for events before the first stored data point.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds from onset. Must be zero, positive, or 'n/a' if unavailable. A zero value indicates an impulse event.

sample.Description: The event onset time in number of sampling points.First sample is 0.

value.Description: Original integer trigger code from the recording

trial_type.Description: Event type — see below for levels

Levels.question: Comprehension question onset (variant)
Levels.unknown_trigger: Trigger not matched to any known category

sequence_id.Description: Sentence sequence index within the run (0-based)

condition.Description: Expected vs unexpected condition for this trial

expected_article.Description: Indefinite article ('a' or 'an') that would be expected in the high-cloze condition

unexpected_article.Description: Indefinite article that would be unexpected in the high-cloze condition

expected_noun.Description: Target noun for the expected condition

unexpected_noun.Description: Target noun for the unexpected condition

plausibility_expected.Description: Mean plausibility rating of the expected noun (1-7 Likert)

plausibility_unexpected.Description: Mean plausibility rating of the unexpected noun (1-7 Likert)

sentence_context.Description: Leading sentence context (text before the critical article/noun)

sentence_ending.Description: Sentence ending (text after the critical noun)

has_question.Description: True if the sentence was followed by a comprehension question

question_text.Description: Text of the comprehension question, if any

question_answer.Description: Correct answer to the comprehension question
